keyEvents.text: Goal! Fortuna Sittard 1, Telstar 0. Mohamed Ihattaren (Fortuna Sittard) converts the penalty with a left footed shot to the high centre of the goal.
Iván Márquez (Fortuna Sittard) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Marvin Peersman (Telstar) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Tyrone Owusu (Telstar) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Own Goal by Sem Valk, Telstar. Fortuna Sittard 2, Telstar 0.
Goal! Fortuna Sittard 2, Telstar 1. Abdelnour Soualhia (Telstar) header from the centre of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Patrick Brouwer following a set piece situation.
Goal! Fortuna Sittard 2, Telstar 2. Patrick Brouwer (Telstar) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner.
First Half ends, Fortuna Sittard 2, Telstar 2.
Substitution, Telstar. Emirhan Demircan replaces Patrick Brouwer.
Substitution, Telstar. Rojendro Oudsten replaces Gabi Caschili.
Substitution, Fortuna Sittard. Sven Simons replaces Iván Márquez.
Isaiah Ahmed (Telstar) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Sven Simons (Fortuna Sittard) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Fortuna Sittard. Yassin Oukili replaces Kristoffer Peterson.
Substitution, Telstar. Jelani Seedorf replaces Nökkvi Thórisson.
Substitution, Telstar. Harrie Kuster replaces Tyrone Owusu.
Substitution, Telstar. Noach Shenkman replaces Isaiah Ahmed.
Delay in match because of an injury Abdelnour Soualhia (Telstar).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Fortuna Sittard. Nick de Groot replaces Jasper Dahlhaus.
Substitution, Fortuna Sittard. Siebe Wylin replaces Shiloh 't Zand.
Second Half ends, Fortuna Sittard 2, Telstar 2.
